qt: to the Commission Gerolf Annemans (PfE) Subject:

Regulation No 1/1958 and Article 24 TFEU guarantee the use of the official languages of the Union. At the same time, the Commission recognises that specialised, urgent or short-term web content is not always available in all 24 official languages and that all content is published at least in English. As a result, information may be available in English before it is available in Dutch. 1.
Does the Commission systematically monitor the time lag between the publication of English and Dutch versions of public information?
What objective criteria does the Commission apply when publishing public information in only a limited number of official languages?
Does the Commission regard machine translation as a fully-fledged alternative to a Dutch-language version that has been checked for accuracy?
at: EN on behalf of the European Commission (19.11.2026) 1. The Commission has a prioritisation process that optimises resources based on the urgency of the information and its interest for the citizens. Such prioritisation, combined with an efficient electronic publishing system, aims at ensuring that important information is made available on the web in a timely manner in all official languages. In this context, having a specific monitoring process would provide no relevant information. 2. The vast majority of Commission webpages are available in all official EU languages. Exceptions are made when the provision of translations is materially impossible or excessively onerous, or when the Commission’s research shows that the audience for a given type of information is overwhelmingly using a specific language. The criteria for language use on Commission websites are published on a dedicated webpage1. 3. The Commission provides machine translation to complement human translation and expand language coverage. When the Commission publishes machine-translated information, it explicitly informs website visitors of this fact and provides additional information about the limitations of this technology2.
